rulings.reason: Step 64 creates an authorization code that step 65 immediately overwrites. No example exchanges the first code and no later act reads its effect. It is padding, not setup.
rulings.requiredFix: Delete step 64 and keep step 65 as the sole setup for step 66.

rulings.reason: These steps claim pre-stream rate-limit faults but none requests streaming, so they exercise ordinary non-streaming faults instead.
rulings.requiredFix: Set body.stream=true on each named step and assert application/json content type and the native error envelope as well as Retry-After. For Messages assert error.type=rate_limit_error and error.error_type=rate_limit_exceeded; for the OpenRouter-shaped pre-stream faults assert error.code=429. Keep the scripted retry value 2: the vendor allows an arbitrary retry interval; no invented fixed vendor default is implied.

rulings.reason: The current Messages errors omit the canonical error.error_type the cited page explicitly includes for native non-streaming envelopes.
rulings.requiredFix: Add equality checks and implement the vendor field: step30 invalid_request; 31 authentication; 32 permission_denied; 33 not_found; 34 rate_limit_exceeded; 35 server; 36 provider_overloaded; 37 provider_overloaded; 92 rate_limit_exceeded. Existing nullable request_id exceptions remain valid for pre-Router/scripted faults; no extra setup is needed.

rulings.reason: Successful inference examples omit checking the documented X-Generation-Id response header, which the pack does not emit.
rulings.requiredFix: Implement the header for streamed and JSON inference responses and add header:x-generation-id exists:true or a nonempty match to every named example. Do not assert a guessed minted identity. No setup changes are required.

rulings.reason: The source-page inventory omits concrete operation examples and an OAuth refusal rule. Passing the current replay count cannot establish that every published example was sent or recorded.
rulings.requiredFix: Apply every exact addition and existing-entry completion in the retained independent review to spec/doc-examples.json. Append each required replay step and only its indispensable setup after original step93; keep original step93 unchanged except for insertion anchoring. Assert request-decided models/identities and error/framing invariants; do not pin generated ids/counts/prices/token usage. Add every listed notReplayed item with its exact evidence-backed missing-mechanism/precondition reason to the fields.notReplayed map. Replay every generation/status fault now supported by the generic kernel mechanism the dispatcher implemented during this judgment. For reachable validation, canonical metadata, post-commit provider faults and method refusals, fix the twin/kernel as needed rather than recording a reachable defect as unavailable. Complete existing debug doc requests/outputs but retain their current truthful exclusions. Existing/latest SDK aliases require separate records. The changed parts allowed here are fields and insertion anchor93; doc inventory and twin fixes are outside this journey hash.

doubts.doubt: The runs of refusals and endpoint variations are vendor-published examples with explicit malformed input, absent credentials, consumed/expired codes or configured scenario faults. Their purpose is replay, so the customer-life tour/refusal bar does not reject them merely for being adjacent.

The six existing exclusions are supported: three require configured guardrails/router metadata; one alias has no dated binding; two require a real transformed provider request. Their inventory is incomplete, but these individual reasons do not excuse an observed reachable twin defect.

findings: Read all 94 steps, every expectation/capture, all 23 doc entries, all six explicit exclusions, all exampleDiffers entries, all six served OpenAPI operations and their input/output examples, plus every executable/output snippet on the cited OAuth/overview/streaming/Responses/errors/limits/Claude integration pages. Example setup uses the application key or signed-in Example Person; code/key/id captures are used consistently. Model snapshot date is 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC; expiry moves to 00:10. S256/plain/no-challenge/headless exchanges are correctly paired. Initial, plain, no-challenge and headless thin-key examples have later own-key effect reads. Single-use setup is consumed before its refusal. Nullable/provider-conditional exampleDiffers have supporting schema/page evidence.
